Pear Upside-Down Ginger Cake
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, December 24, 2009 - 2:05pm

Ingredients




4 lg. ripe comice pears
2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice
 cup light brown sugar
1 1/4 cups unbleached, all purpose flour
 cup granulated sugar
1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder
2/3 cup plain yogurt, whisked until smooth
Pinch of salt
1 teaspoon ground ginger
1/2 teaspoon ground cloves
1 lg. beaten egg
2 tablespoons molasses

Preparation

1 Peel, core and cut pears into large pieces. In a non-aluminum mixing bowl, combine pears and lemon juice. Distribute brown sugar evenly over bottom of ungreased 8 inch round baking pan. Spread pears evenly on top. Combine flour, sugar, baking powder, salt, ginger, and cloves. In separate bowl, beat together egg, yogurt, and molasses.
